question_text: A messenger travels at 30 km/h to an office and returns at 60 km/h. Average speed?

hint_ladder.title: Harmonic Mean, Hindi Arithmetic
hint_ladder.text: Kapag same distance, average speed ay harmonic mean, hindi (30+60)/2=45. Gamitin ang total distance over total time.

hint_ladder.title: Mag-assume ng Distance
hint_ladder.text: Pumili ng convenient distance, halimbawa 60 km (LCM ng 30 at 60). Papunta = 60/30=2 oras, pabalik = 60/60=1 oras.

hint_ladder.title: Total Distance at Oras
hint_ladder.text: Total distance = 60+60 = 120 km. Total time = 2+1 = 3 oras.

hint_ladder.title: Kalkulahin ang Average
hint_ladder.text: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time = 120 km ÷ 3 h = 40 km/h. Boom!

A.text: Correct. Average speed = total distance / total time. For 60 km each way, total 120 km, 3h, gives 40 km/h.

B.text: You might have chosen 42 km/h because you mistakenly weighed averages, but correct weighted average gives 40.

C.text: You might have chosen 45 km/h because you simply averaged speeds, forgetting that time differs when distances are equal.

D.text: You might have chosen 48 km/h because of a miscalculation in the harmonic mean formula.

next_time_rule: Mental Trick: Kapag same distance, average speed = 2ab/(a+b). Parang jeep na pabalik-balik sa terminal, di pareho oras.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo, messenger ka sa City Hall, nagde-deliver ng documents sa Barangay Hall, 30 km/h papunta, 60 km/h pabalik. Dahil pareho ang distansya, gamitin natin harmonic mean.

Para mas madali, pumili tayo ng distance na 60 km (LCM ng 30 at 60). Oras papunta: 60 km ÷ 30 km/h = 2 oras. Oras pabalik: 60 km ÷ 60 km/h = 1 oras.

Total distance: 120 km. Total time: 3 oras. Average speed = 120 km ÷ 3 h = 40 km/h.

**Watch-Out Zone: simple_average_fallacy** sa pag-aakalang pareho ang oras, pero hindi.
